name: RecordHTML
description: Official hosted server for RecordHTML. Records a public web page, or an HTML document the agent writes (banners, ads, animations, landing pages), to MP4, WebM or GIF in a real browser and returns a signed video link. Each recording reports dropped frames, page errors and failed requests. Tools: record_html, get_recording, estimate_recording, list_recordings, delete_recording. OAuth and a RecordHTML account are required; the free plan includes 10 credits a month.
author: RecordHTML
